summary: Review founder-led outbound messages for relevance, credibility, asymmetry of effort and a reply-sized next step rather than generic personalization theatre.

must_inspect.why: The opening should establish a reason this recipient was selected without pretending generic firmographics are insight.
false_positive_guards: Do not require deep personalization when the segment-specific problem is itself narrow and credible.

must_inspect.why: A cold recipient needs enough reason to believe the message before being asked for meaningful time or access.
false_positive_guards: A low-friction question may need less proof than a meeting request or paid-pilot ask.

must_inspect.why: The requested next step should match the relationship and uncertainty level.
false_positive_guards: Do not label a meeting CTA high-friction when prior context already established interest.
Do not invent recipient motives or inbox behavior.
handoff_triggers: Prospect selection -> design-partner-finder or prospecting specialist
